notes: Strip a: x 0-2280 plus overlap to ~2600. Reading Road printed 'ROAD' near the top and 'READING' near the bottom-left; the band between the plate's west edge and the east street line is taken as the road (interior lines are pipes/tracks). No suffix printed in this strip for Tennessee, Sherman, Courtland, Weyer, Cleveland, Mills (recorded bare). West Street is printed 'WEST' ... 'ST.' (address run between). Webster read from 'WEBSTE...' cut by plate edge. Two partly cut names west of Reading Road: '...E AVE.' (top, y~118) and '...YARD AVE.' (y~3550, under a cloth patch). The 40 ft N-S street at x~2560-2610 between Cleveland and Mills has 'CITY LIMITS' printed in it and no name. Not streets: Norfolk & Western R.R. (curving through x 1700-2370), the Cincinnati/Norwood city-limit lines (blue/pink/grey bands), the yellow sheet outlines, the lot line at y~2590 (1689.06'), the line at y~3890 ('CITY LIMITS 659.16'). Possible 20 ft strip between the yellow sheet line and the grey city-limit line at y~6195-6228 (x 2050-2780, south of lots 91-96) not recorded as a street: no name, looks like the gap between two boundaries.
